# VC-PW-5310

Manufacturer: MEAN WELL Enterprises Co., Ltd.
Series: SDR-120.
The enclosure uses this outline for SDR-120-24.

Source file: `SDR-120-3D.zip` from
https://www.meanwell.com/upload/pdf/SDR-120/SDR-120-3D.zip
The archive contains `SDR-120/SDR-120.stp`.
That STEP file is 14.7 MB.
It is not stored in this repository.

`SDR-120-exterior.step` keeps the four largest solids.
Those solids are the case and the terminal parts.
The bounding box after `Rot(0, 0, -90)` is 40.0 x 126.26 x 128.96 mm.
That is the full file outline.
The fifth solid does not change the outline and it pushes the file above 10 MB.
Local X is the rail width.
Local Y is the depth. The curved terminal cover is at positive Y.
Local Z is the height. The vent grid is on the top face.
